_comment: Hand-maintained sidecar of docs/tools/agents_docs_index.py (DOC-02 section 3, SPEC-01 section 3.2). One entry per major directory, depth at most 2 below src/mission_control. The generator renders the root Code map from `purpose` (first sentence) and writes a generated block into <path>/AGENTS.md. Fields: id, title, path, purpose, pin_first (root map rank), pin_files (entrypoints listed first), tests, verify, program, invariants (0-3 lines). Explained by, Decided by, Depends on and Used by are derived, never written here.

modules.title: Deep Agents lane adapter
modules.purpose: Deep Agents lane (ADR-0005): bounded cognition over LangGraph, never forked. It runs on deepagents extended through public interfaces, executes what the binding pins and schedules nothing.
verify: uv run pytest tests/integration/deep_agents (real local stack; paid calls need authorization)
invariants: Never choose a model, tool or skill the binding did not name; refuse mismatches.
Model clients and credentials stay server-side, never in prompts, files, checkpoints or artifacts.
An uncertain provider state is reconciled, never relaunched; checkpoints are recovery state, not mission truth.

modules.title: Operation execution contracts
modules.purpose: Provider-neutral operation execution contracts, no I/O. Covers execution and environment bindings, lane describe and turn payloads, the journal, checkpoint lineage, cognition points, materialization receipts, saved-result settlement and usage admission.
invariants: Provider-neutral: the contracts here name no provider SDK type.
Settlement is by saved result and reducer; execution completion is not mission acceptance.

modules.title: Authoring use cases
modules.purpose: Mission Manifest compile, submit and start use cases. Also the production launch inputs of a manifest run, per-lane launch bindings (local providers and Cursor), the subagent discriminator and the control-plane repository port.
invariants: Fail closed at fresh launch when authored acceptance has no runtime evaluator.

modules.title: Execution environments
modules.purpose: Environment resolution, preparation gate and network projection. Resolves an environment request into mc.environment_binding.v1 and attests it; also owns preparation records, Environment Kits and hosted provider environments.

modules.title: Temporal execution mechanics
modules.purpose: Workflows and activities: mission_run, stagegraph, goal_directed, operation. Also the Temporal client, search attributes, visibility, worker versioning and the production lane composition factories.
verify: uv run pytest tests/integration/temporal (needs real Temporal and PostgreSQL)
invariants: Workflow code is deterministic; activities call application services.
Scoped child IDs cannot collide across installations, applications or tenants.
Submission replay verifies the actual first-history input before issuing a receipt.

modules.title: Recovery, forks and reconciliation
modules.purpose: Macro snapshots, semantic forks, reconciliation and terminal-evidence adoption. Also cognitive seeds, interventions and repairs, and closed-workflow cancellation recovery.

modules.title: Workflow family interpretation
modules.purpose: Pure Stage Graph and GoalDirected interpretation; interpreters propose only. Covers routes, dependencies, payload bounds, completion evidence, watchers, Human Gates and recursive composition rules; they never terminalize a run.
verify: uv run pytest tests/unit/orchestration tests/unit/watchers tests/architecture
invariants: Do not turn an interpreter proposal into an authoritative lifecycle change.
Deterministic and free of I/O imports.

modules.title: Family orchestration use cases
modules.purpose: Stage Graph and GoalDirected orchestration use cases over persisted authority. Covers the orchestration service, named-output settlement, completion validation, linked runs, nested bodies, Human Gate wiring and fork templates.

modules.title: General runtime navigation
modules.purpose: Runtime layers: contracts, domain, application, adapters, interfaces, bootstrap. A request becomes an admitted immutable binding, then a scoped Temporal root, family decisions, bounded operations and durable settlements.
invariants: Interpreters propose; reducers authorize and terminalize.
Provider objects stay outside the domain; application-specific integrations stay outside this package.

modules.title: Public contracts
modules.purpose: Public envelopes: commands, inspection, admission, canonical digests. Also scoped identities and the hook, realtime, Context Packet and Knowledge Operation Protocol wire contracts.
invariants: Changing canonical bytes changes idempotency and immutable pins.
A contract request cannot inject trusted actor, pool or installation authority.

modules.title: Pure rules and decisions
modules.purpose: Pure rules and decisions with no I/O. Covers programs, execution, authoring, composition, context, resolution, capabilities, outputs and reactions; policies are explicit admitted inputs.
invariants: Imports no Temporal, database client, FastAPI or provider SDK.
Determinism and immutable content identity hold across retries and forks.

modules.title: Authoring domain
modules.purpose: Mission Manifest, MissionDefinition@1, Environment Kits and the compiler. Covers manifest v1 and v2 (YAML) lowered to immutable definitions; the package root re-exports lazily so a leaf module does not load the compiler.
invariants: Definitions are immutable once compiled; identifiers derive from the parts that identify a record.

modules.title: Provider frames and transcript rules
modules.purpose: Provider Frames, closing facts, usage and Transcript renderers. A Provider Frame is the lane-neutral record of what a provider said; the renderers emit JSONL for agents and Markdown for humans.
invariants: Frame bodies are canonical JSON with secrets redacted and a bounded excerpt.

modules.title: Application logic
modules.purpose: Use cases that map public controls to domain rules behind ports. Covers missions, execution, programs, recovery, subordinates and capabilities; concrete SDK clients and SQL belong in adapters, composition in bootstrap.
invariants: Never choose a provider fallback or install a permissive policy because a binding is missing.

modules.title: Selection Workspace
modules.purpose: The Selection Workspace: faceted search and read-only draft check. One search and one read-only check of a draft lane, model and capability selection.
invariants: The check is read-only; it never writes selection state.

modules.title: Mission application handlers
modules.purpose: Mission admission, lifecycle facade, inspection and run retrieval. Handlers over the durable runtime authority: scoped admission and governed launch, the facade over the reducer and boundary relay, and runtime saga adapters.

modules.title: Concrete adapters
modules.purpose: Concrete I/O behind the application ports. Covers postgres, temporal, deep_agents, agent_server and the other lanes, storage, auth, realtime and operations; there is no general infrastructure catchall for new implementations.
invariants: Adapters implement application ports; they cannot invent completion semantics, privileged grants or cross-application routing.
No paid provider experiment without finite authorization.

modules.title: PostgreSQL authority
modules.purpose: Scoped repositories, immutable content and transaction boundaries. Runtime and family-writer roles stay distinct; every statement is schema-qualified and runs in an explicit transaction after scope is applied.
verify: uv run pytest tests/integration/postgres (needs real PostgreSQL)
invariants: Apply scope on every acquired connection; never use schema-owner credentials as a fallback.
Schema changes belong to the db-contract package; migrations/ here is historical and never applied live.

modules.title: Agent Server hosting
modules.purpose: Hosts the bounded LangGraph graphs of the Agent Server (ADR-0006). Covers the graph registry, entrypoints for subordinate and async child graphs, deployment-selected topology, authentication, health and tracing.
verify: uv run pytest tests/integration/agent_server (needs the local Agent Server)
invariants: Entrypoints are bounded graphs; Temporal alone schedules missions.
Topology is selected by the server deployment, never by a request.

modules.title: Capability custody adapters
modules.purpose: Capability bundle custody, MCP registry, browser and skill discovery. Covers immutable skill bundles and their object store, browser subprocess transport, npx skills discovery, quarantine inspection and capability pins.
invariants: Bundles are complete immutable directories; no archive extraction or install hooks.

modules.title: Cursor lane family
modules.purpose: Cursor lane family (ADR-0030): cursor_local and cursor_cloud. Local uses the pinned SDK bridge, git worktree leases and fail-closed Kernel Hooks; cloud uses Cloud Agents API v1 with SCM branches; both map frames and reconcile billed cost.
verify: uv run pytest tests/integration/cursor (paid provider calls need authorization)
invariants: Importing this package imports no SDK; the SDK loads lazily inside the bridge adapter.

modules.title: Claude Agent SDK lane
modules.purpose: The local claude_agent_sdk lane. Covers the single session stream owner, the SDK client factory, message-to-frame mapping, Kernel Hooks as in-process callbacks, permission bindings to the approval broker, workspace and continuation.
verify: uv run pytest tests/integration/claude (paid provider calls need authorization)
invariants: Exports load lazily so the describe aggregator can read describe without importing the harness.

modules.title: Codex lane
modules.purpose: The codex lane: Codex app-server over stdio on a worker. Covers the typed JSON-RPC protocol subset, transport, subprocess launcher, approvals over the broker, frame mapping, hook trust and continuation.
verify: uv run pytest tests/integration/codex (paid provider calls need authorization)
invariants: Nothing here logs in, starts a model turn on its own or reads a credential value.

modules.title: Public transport
modules.purpose: Transport only: http, cli, mcp and socketio. They call application handlers and never implement a second lifecycle reducer or scheduler.
invariants: Authenticate before resolving scoped services; verify scope against the trusted installation, application and tenant.
Request fields and token metadata cannot select pools, grants, bootstrap factories or provider credentials.

modules.title: HTTP routes
modules.purpose: Typed application-scoped HTTP operations. Covers mission manifest verbs, run control and forks, runtime inspection, transcript and artifacts, catalog, subscriptions, signal ingress, human tasks, selection and model profiles.
invariants: Keep replay response semantics and structured rejection codes explicit.

modules.title: missionctl CLI
modules.purpose: missionctl: a thin authenticated client, never a second lifecycle authority. Works over the public HTTP surface; includes wait and inbox, outputs, selection, knowledge review, setup and token helpers.
invariants: Credentials are written to a new file, never to standard output.

modules.title: MCP servers
modules.purpose: Coordinator and operator MCP servers and the governed gateway. Tools cover mission, run-control, transcript, selection, human-task, cognition-point and signal operations, inbox and subscriptions; the gateway fronts Mission-Control-owned effect tools.

modules.title: Trusted composition and startup
modules.purpose: Trusted startup and composition. Covers the API and worker factories, read-only preflight, the common-release check and the wiring of repositories and services; bootstrap passes the application id explicitly and never discovers profiles.
invariants: storage_mode is production_common only; missing or mismatched evidence fails closed with no transitional fallback.
Startup never migrates schema, invents catalog definitions or policy grants, or fetches token-supplied keys.

modules.title: Common database component
modules.purpose: Common SQL, releases and the mission-db admin tool (ADR-0003). Holds immutable releases and seeds; mission-db installs, verifies and seeds a release into one application database. The runtime never imports it.
verify: make test-db-contract (disposable PostgreSQL 17 + pgvector, MISSION_CONTROL_TEST_ADMIN_DSN set)
invariants: A release is immutable once applied: add a new component version and seed version, never edit bytes.
Every apply, runtime-apply and seed-apply writes a receipt; verify compares fingerprint and contract digest.

modules.title: Optional Biotech integration
modules.purpose: Optional Biotech adapters; the kernel never imports them. Application-specific schema grounding, research and Neo4j adapters (namespace biotech_mission_adapters); deployment composition supplies their policies explicitly.
verify: uv run --group biotech pytest tests/unit/reference_research tests/unit/web_research
invariants: The kernel never imports this package.
No entity writer here; Biotech domain writes arrive through the Knowledge Services intent and receipt contract.

modules.title: Verification navigation
modules.purpose: Where each kind of proof lives. unit covers pure contracts and reducers, integration real PostgreSQL and Temporal boundaries, acceptance/mission_control authenticated scoped execution, conformance every lane against its fake, qualification/two_project the common release.
invariants: Never hide a missing service behind a new default skip.
Destructive fixture setup never targets live or unknown databases.

modules.title: Shipped skill bundles
modules.purpose: Shipped agent skill bundles with digest manifests. Includes the mission-control router skill, the author, catalog, compose, intervene and observe skills, mc-signals, the mc-cognition-* skills and the knowledge charters.
verify: make skills-manifest (rewrites digests after editing a bundle)
invariants: A bundle's manifest.json digests must match the files on disk.

modules.title: Deployment inputs
modules.purpose: Per-application and per-environment deployment inputs, not code. Holds application.toml, models.toml, target.toml and release.lock.json per application, plus the cloud runtime plan, hosted packs, cognition profiles, Vercel ingress and examples.
invariants: release.lock.json and hosted-pack files are LF-pinned; their digests hash LF bytes.
No secrets or private runtime receipts.

modules.title: Agent Server deployment config
modules.purpose: LangGraph Agent Server deployment config. langgraph.json maps graph ids to mission_control.adapters.agent_server entrypoints and names the auth and http app; runtime.env carries the server environment. The code lives in src/mission_control/adapters/agent_server.
